The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: at no time.

notes: Use "nigdy" with a negated verb to mean "never" (e.g., "nigdy nie wiem" - I never know). Note that Polish requires a double negative when "nigdy" is used with verbs.

senses.definition: At no time in the past or future; on no occasion.

examples.translation: I will never forget this day.
examples.emotion: firm and deeply sincere, promising to hold onto a memory forever

senses.definition: At any time (used in questions or after certain conjunctions, equivalent to 'ever').

examples.translation: Have you ever been to Warsaw?
examples.emotion: curious and friendly, asking about someone's life experiences
